landingPage.heroTitle: Yoga and pilates class timetable template
landingPage.heroDescription: A single-page studio site that shows your weekly classes, counts down to the next one and sends visitors to your booking link.
landingPage.about: Class Timetable is a single-page website for a yoga or pilates studio whose schedule repeats every week. Instead of a PDF nobody updates, the page opens with a live countdown to the next class and a weekly grid of every session with its time, length, level and focus. The next class is highlighted and moves on as soon as one starts, and a running class is marked as in session. Booking goes to the scheduling tool you already use, with phone and email as a fallback. Classes, studio details and FAQs live in data files, so a timetable change takes minutes. It is built with Astro and TypeScript and deploys from GitHub to Hostinger.

features.title: Next-class countdown
features.description: A live countdown to the next class, worked out from your weekly schedule with no dates to update.

features.title: Weekly class grid
features.description: Every class across the week with its start time, duration, level and a one-line focus.

features.title: Next and in-session states
features.description: The next class glows, and a running class gets an in-session badge with its end time.

features.title: Booking handoff
features.description: Each class and button opens your scheduling link, or phone and email when you have none.

features.title: Timetable in one file
features.description: Classes and studio details live in data files, so changing the schedule takes minutes.

features.title: Calm on every screen
features.description: Accessible layouts with reduced-motion support that work from phones to desktops.
